---
title: "CVD indicators"
---

This area brings together the current public cardiovascular disease (CVD) indicators published by the Barbados National Registry.

## Current indicators

### [CVD burden](burden/index.qmd)

Counts and composition of hospital-registered CVD events. The dashboard uses the current public release and applies the BNR statistical disclosure-control policy.

Further CVD indicator groups will be added here as they are published.
